contributorNotInProject: Only project members can be added as collaborators

draftCategoryChoice: The category must be one this space has: {names}

draftEditNeedsFind: Each edit needs the passage it replaces
draftEditNotFound: The passage to replace is not in the description; read the draft and copy it exactly

draftFileNotYours: Only files you uploaded yourself can be used

draftIncomplete: The draft is not complete yet; missing: {fields}
draftKeepsASubmissionItem: Keep at least one submission item
draftLockingChoice: Team changes must be allowed, locked once the application is approved, or locked once the team starts
draftMentorChoice: {name} cannot be a mentor; the choices are: {names}
draftNameLength: The name cannot be empty and is at most 100 characters
draftNeedsSpace: A new draft needs a space
draftNeedsTarget: Name a draft or a task
draftNumberRange: {field} must be a whole number from {low} to {high}
draftSubmissionEmpty: At least one submission item is required
draftSubmissionKind: A submission item is a file or text, as the form names them
draftStageChoice: A stage has to be one the task has, by its id or name: {names}
draftStageAmbiguous: More than one stage is called “{name}”; name it by its id
draftStageRemovedRows: The removed stages took these submission items and rubric lines with them: {names}
draftTagChoice: The tags {unknown} are not in this space; it has: {names}
draftMaterialChoice: The files {unknown} are not in this space's library; it has: {names}
draftSkillChoice: The skills {unknown} are not ones a task can give; the choices are: {names}

draftTaskNotYours: Only the publisher and the space's admins can change this task
draftTemplateChoice: The template must be one this space has: {names}
draftTooLarge: The draft is too long to save
draftTooMany: A space keeps at most {max} drafts per person; delete ones you no longer need
draftUnknownFields: The draft has no such fields: {fields}
mentorConsentRequired: This task has mentors; agree to them joining your project to start it
mentorNotSpaceAdmin: {handle} is not an admin of this space and cannot be a mentor
rubricLineNeedsName: Every rubric line needs a criterion name
rubricLineTooLong: A rubric line is too long: names are up to {item} characters, standards up to {criteria}
rubricPointsRange: Rubric points must be a whole number from 0 to {max}
rubricTooManyLines: A rubric has at most {max} lines
stageHasSubmissions: Stage “{name}” already has submissions and cannot be removed
stageIdDuplicate: Two stages have the same id: {id}
stageIdInvalid: The stage id “{id}” is not valid: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, up to 16 characters
stageReferenceUnknown: A submission item or rubric line belongs to a stage that does not exist
stageTooLong: A stage is too long: names are up to {name} characters, descriptions up to {description}
stageTooMany: A task has at most {max} stages
submissionChallengeEnded: This challenge has ended, so no work can be handed in
submissionClaimNotApproved: Your application must be approved before you can hand work in
submissionPastDeadline: Your submission deadline has passed, so no version can be handed in or changed. Ask the challenge's author to extend it
submissionStagePastDue: Stage “{name}” is past its due date: you can no longer hand in a new version or change one you handed in. Ask the publisher for an extension
taskBriefIsGenerated: {name} is generated from the task's content and follows every change to it. It can't be replaced or deleted on its own
taskCreatedByPerson: Only a person can create a task this way
taskEarlierPending: This publisher has earlier tasks waiting for review; review those first
taskFilesForTakers: Only the publisher, a space admin or someone working on this task can download its materials
taskPlacesFull: All {limit} places on this task are taken
taskLockingPolicyInvalid: The team membership setting is not valid
taskStartModeInvalid: How a task starts is either start directly or apply first
taskOpeningNotFailed: The AI teammate didn't fail when it took on this task; there is nothing to retry
taskCloseWhileInReview: A card on this task is waiting for its reviewer's decision. Closing the task would void the card and close its pull request, and that decision is not yours, so the task was not closed. The reviewer accepts or returns it on the card; if they said in the conversation that they accept it, ask them to press accept on the card. Wrap up once the card is decided.
taskOwnSessionCloses: Only the task's owner, its collaborators, or the AI teammate working in the task's conversation can close it
taskOwnSessionReopens: Only project members whose role has “Create and review tasks”, or the AI teammate working in the task's conversation, can reopen it
taskOwnSessionReportsProgress: Only the AI teammate working in this task's conversation can report its progress
taskOwnerNotInProject: A task can only be handed to a project member
taskOwnerOnly: Only the task's owner can do this
taskParticipantsOnly: Only the task's owner and collaborators can do this
taskProgressWhileInReview: A card is waiting on this task's review, and the card says where the task stands until then. Once the card is returned or voided the task is back in progress, and you can report its state again
taskReviewAdminsOnly: Only the space's admins can review tasks
taskTeamSizeTeamOnly: Only team tasks can set a team size
taskTitleTooLong: This title doesn't fit one sidebar line: a line holds about {limit} half-width characters (a CJK character counts as 2) and this one is {now}. Write a shorter one and try again.
teammateTaskByTeammate: Only an AI teammate creates tasks here
teammateTaskHereOnlyInThread: Only a thread can be turned into a task in place
teammateTaskSummaryRequired: A new task needs a summary of what it is for

starterRemovedBeforePush: The publisher removed this starter code before it reached the repository
starterPushGaveUp: The code repository service kept refusing the starter code, so the platform stopped trying
starterMainTaken: The code repository's main branch already had other commits before the starter code could be added
stageEffectFailing: Participants with a stage past its due date and nothing handed in: {n}. Saving marks them as failed
stageEffectReopening: Participants going from failed back to in progress: {n}
taskStartModeLocked: Someone has already applied for or started this task, so how it starts can no longer change
claimHasNewerApplication: This application has a newer one; decide the newer one instead
taskClosedForStart: This task has closed; it can no longer be applied for or started
claimDeadlinePassedForStart: Your hand-in deadline has passed, so you can no longer start this task
claimBeingChanged: This application is being changed. Try again in a moment
